# اُعْتُبِرَا (uʕtubirā) /uʕ.tu.bi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اِعْتَبِرَا (iʕtabirā) /iʕ.ta.bi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
